description: Without id: creates a new object (rectangle, or a tile object when gid is given); the id comes from nextobjectid, which is raised afterwards. With id: changes exactly the fields that were passed. Shape changes and template instances are not editable in v1 and are rejected.

dry_run.description: true = compute and report everything, but write nothing. Default: false.

gid.description: GID for a tile object, flip bits allowed.

id.description: Id of an existing object. Without id a new one is created.

layer.description: Name of the layer; inside groups also 'group/layer'. Alternatively use layer_id.

layer_id.description: Id of the layer. Unique, unlike the name. Alternatively use layer.

path.description: Path to ONE Tiled map file (.tmx or .tmj) — no directory, no wildcards. Please pass it absolute: a relative path is resolved against the working directory of the server process, and that is chosen by the MCP host, not by the project.

x.description: X position in pixels. Required when creating.

y.description: Y position in pixels. Required when creating.

name: object_upsert
title: Create or change an object
